Map of the Helles war zone of Gallipoli, 1915.

Alçitepe = Krithia
Aytepe = Hill 138
Delile Sirti = Fir Tree Spur
Karacaoğlu Tepe = Hill 114
Kemal Bey Tepe = Haricot
Kanli Dere = Achi Baba Nullah
